# LDraw fixture: Brick 2 x 4 (3001)

These files are unchanged, verbatim LDraw Parts Library test fixtures. They
exercise BrickForge's Python resolver against a real part and its nested
sub-part/primitive dependency tree.

- Upstream project: https://library.ldraw.org/
- Convenience mirror used to retrieve the fixture files: https://github.com/erik-larsen/ldraw
- Root source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/erik-larsen/ldraw/main/parts/3001.dat
- The fixture includes the source files required by the root part's type-1 references.
- Original file headers, contributor names and licence notices are retained.
- The individual part files carry CC BY 4.0 notices; CAreadme.txt and
  CAlicense4.txt are included unchanged.

This fixture is for tests only. It is not a complete library snapshot and does
not replace validation against a version-pinned official LDraw archive.
